reviewer: Same author, manual full-response review; no independent judge
conclusion: No improvement in case pass rate demonstrated on this small constrained authored benchmark.
limitations: Text-artifact reasoning only; browsing/tools forbidden, sandbox read-only.
No automatic trigger-selection, live crawling, real edits/deployment, or rankings tested.
Expected rubric visible to reviewer; same-author grading is not independent.
Local skill catalog disabled/one-token limit; three catalog-removal warnings retained; preflight returned NONE.
Two operational timeouts retained; identical candidate/config retries produce the missing responses.
Initial 48-response exploratory round is separate, excluded from the controlled comparison.
